title: Bias Evaluation and Mitigation in Retrieval-Augmented Medical Question-Answering Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Generating demographic-specific query variants by substituting race attributes (Caucasian, African American, Asian, Hispanic) into medical QA query stems and measuring disparities in retrieval overlap, QA accuracy, Demographic Parity (DP), and Equal Opportunity (EO).
